Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/0-09.htm.text: Dark Knight Mordred: Thanks for your hard work! Congratulations, you're a Hell Knight! Good job!

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/0-010.htm.text: Dark Knight Mordred: You're still not quite ready for a class transfer. Come back when you're older! (Only a character of level 76 or above may transfer to the Hell Knight class. Don't abandon the quest until class transfer is complete.)

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/0-04.htm.text: Dark Knight Mordred: Have you forgotten what you're supposed to do? Go see Spellbook Seller Elena in Goddard Castle Town .

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/0-06.htm.text: Dark Knight Mordred: Come in. When Elena brought me the translated ancient document, she told me that you were almost finished with the mission. What happened? You ran into Hallate? You could've been killed! This is marvelous! Have you obtained the knowledge of the stone tablet?

By the way, congratulations on completing the pilgrimage of the Tablet of Vision! You're more that qualified to be a Hell Knight! In fact, I'll promote you myself! Congratulations! You're a a Hell Knight!

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
